description: Schedule a GitHub Projects backlog into Google Calendar, as a CLI or an MCP server.
name: io.github.danielsousaoliveira/cal-auto-python

environmentVariables.description: GitHub personal access token used to query the GitHub Project.
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: GitHub Projects V2 node ID of the board to read.
environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_PROJECT_ID

environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone name used to schedule events, e.g. Europe/Lisbon.
environmentVariables.name: CAL_AUTO_TIMEZONE

environmentVariables.description: Directory holding Google OAuth credentials and token. Defaults to the platform config directory.
environmentVariables.name: CAL_AUTO_CONFIG_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Start of the working day as HH:MM. Defaults to 09:00.
environmentVariables.name: CAL_AUTO_WORKING_DAY_START

environmentVariables.description: End of the working day as HH:MM. Defaults to 17:00.
environmentVariables.name: CAL_AUTO_WORKING_DAY_END

environmentVariables.description: Google Calendar ID to schedule events into. Defaults to primary.
environmentVariables.name: CAL_AUTO_CALENDAR_ID

environmentVariables.description: Google Tasks list ID to create tasks in. Defaults to @default.
environmentVariables.name: CAL_AUTO_TASK_LIST_ID

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated email addresses to invite to scheduled events.
environmentVariables.name: CAL_AUTO_ATTENDEES

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated GitHub Project status names to schedule. Defaults to Backlog.
environmentVariables.name: CAL_AUTO_SCHEDULABLE_STATUSES

environmentVariables.description: Whether all-day events count against free/busy slots. Defaults to false.
environmentVariables.name: CAL_AUTO_COUNT_ALL_DAY_EVENTS
